name: Corn Chowder
description: A creamy corn chowder with bacon, potatoes, and a touch of milk.
recipeIngredient: 1½ cups frozen or fresh corn kernels

recipeInstructions.text: Chop bacon and sauté in a large heavy pot with onions for 5 minutes.
Add celery and cook until onions are transparent.
Stir in flour, salt, and pepper. Cook for 4 minutes.
Gradually blend in hot stock, then add potatoes. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add corn and simmer for another 10 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
Scald milk and add to soup for desired consistency.

keywords: corn chowder, creamy soup, bacon soup

_similar.name: Microwave Corn Chowder
_similar.description: A creamy corn chowder made in the microwave with potatoes, carrots, celery, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: 2 cans (14¾ oz each) cream style corn

recipeInstructions.text: Place water in a 2-quart microwave-safe dish; cover and heat until boiling.
Add potatoes, carrots, celery, onion, salt, and pepper. Cook, uncovered, on high for 8 to 10 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender; set aside (do not drain).
In a 3-quart dish, microwave butter on high for 50 to 60 seconds or until melted.
Stir in flour until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Cook, uncovered, on high for 6 to 7 minutes or until thickened, stirring every 2 minutes.
Add the cheese. Heat for 1 to 1½ minutes or until the cheese is melted.
Stir in corn and reserved vegetables. Cook on high for 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through.

_similar.keywords: microwave corn chowder, creamy soup, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Meat and Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole with ground beef, sliced potatoes, and corn, topped with a savory gravy.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Season with salt and pepper.
Layer sliced potatoes in an 8L casserole dish.
Mix the gravy mix with 1 cup water and pour over the potatoes. Add remaining water.
Top with corn and the browned meat mixture.
Cover and cook at 350°F for 50 minutes.

_similar.keywords: meat casserole, potato and corn dish, gravy topping

_similar.name: Cheesy Ham Chowder
_similar.description: A creamy, cheesy ham chowder with potatoes, carrots, and corn, finished with crispy bacon.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large soup kettle or Dutch oven, cook the bacon over medium heat until crisp. Remove to paper towels to drain.
In the bacon drippings, sauté the chopped onion until tender.
Stir in the flour until blended. Gradually add the milk and water, bringing to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Add the potatoes, corn, bouillon granules, and pepper. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Add the shredded cheese and cubed ham; heat until cheese is melted. Stir in the cooked bacon.

_similar.keywords: ham chowder, cheesy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Hamburger Pie
_similar.description: A savory pie made with ground beef, green beans, and tomato soup, topped with a layer of mashed potatoes and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 4 Tbsp oil in a pan and brown the sliced onion.
Add the hamburger, salt, and pepper to the pan and brown the meat.
Add the cooked green beans and tomato soup to the meat mixture and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with warm milk and beaten egg.
Spoon the mashed potatoes in mounds over the top of the meat mixture in the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Cornbread Salad
_similar.description: A layered salad with crumbled cornbread, black beans, corn, cheese, and a creamy dressing, perfect for chilling before serving.
recipeIngredient: 1 (11 oz) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (15 oz) can black beans, rinsed and drained
½ cup salad dressing or mayonnaise
½ cup chopped fresh cilantro or parsley
6 plum or tiny tim tomatoes, shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions and let cool. Crumble into pieces.
In a food processor or blender, combine salad dressing (or mayonnaise), lime juice, cumin, and salt. Process until smooth.
Layer half of the lettuce, cornbread, dressing mixture, beans, corn, cheese, red bell pepper, green onions, and tomatoes in a 4-quart bowl.
Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining dressing on top. Garnish as desired with cilantro or onion curls.
Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

_similar.keywords: Cornbread salad, layered salad, Southwestern salad
